texts.name: a-good-take

sentences.original: Nella Scur takes on any ladder — three ring-patterns on one shoulder, which every matcher's chart says is a body that should have died at four years old — and it has never once been useful to her, because her tolerances wane on no schedule at all and she learns she is due by bleeding in the middle of a room.
